questions.scenario: Two kids are talking about the talent show at school.
questions.question:
Girl: I want to be in the show. I can dance.
Boy: Wow! ___________________
Girl: No, I can't. But I can dance well.
questions.explanation: 根據女孩的否定回答 No, I can't. 可以推論男孩是以助動詞 Can 提問，且動作必須由第二人稱 you 執行。選項 B 為嚴重文法錯誤的 Are you sing；選項 C 前後句語氣過於冗長；選項 D 錯搭助動詞 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒注意到下半句回答的 can't，選成沒有助動詞呼應的 Do you。

questions.scenario: A brother asks his sister to help him practice a song.
questions.question:
Brother: I need help. Can you sing?
Sister: ___________________
options: No, you can't. You can't sing.
Yes, I do. Let's sing together.
Yes, I can. Let's sing together.
Yes, I am. Let's sing together.
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Can you...? 提問，第一人稱的肯定簡答為 Yes, I can.。選項 B 錯搭 do；選項 C 人稱對應錯誤且意思矛盾；選項 D 錯搭 Be 動詞 am。
questions.commonMisconception: 把 Yes, I am. 當作所有問句的萬用回答，忘記在此要對應情態助動詞 can。

questions.scenario: A mother is asking her son about his little baby sister.
questions.question:
Mom: Your baby sister is one year old now. ___________________
Son: Yes, she can. She can walk to the sofa.
questions.explanation: 從兒子回答 Yes, she can. 知道問句必定為助動詞 Can 開頭。詢問能力使用 Can she...?。選項 B, D 為嚴重的 Be 動詞疊加錯誤；選項 C 語意未對準『能力』。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看懂回答線索，並且對於動詞前疊加 Be 動詞沒有病識感 (Is she walk)。

questions.scenario: At the zoo, a little boy is looking at a fish in the tank.
questions.question:
Boy: Look at the small fish. Can it fly?
Mom: ___________________
options: No, it can't. It can swim.
No, it isn't. It is swim.
Yes, it can. It can swim.
questions.explanation: 魚不會飛，且問句為 Can it...?，否定回答需為 No, it can't.。後半句補充說明魚會游泳 It can swim。選項 B 單複數與 Be 動詞完全錯亂；選項 C 使用 doesn't 無法對應 Can；選項 D 前言不對後語 (會飛卻游水)。
questions.commonMisconception: 常識判斷加上助動詞對應，很多學生會被 It is swim 這種中式英文干擾。

questions.scenario: During a magic show, a magician pulls a rabbit from a hat.
questions.question:
Magician: Here is a rabbit! ___________________
Boy: Yes, it can. Look at it hop!
questions.explanation: 男孩的回答也是 Yes, it can.，代表主詞必須是單數的 it，且動詞要是 Can。因此選項 A 完美契合。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤；選項 C 錯用 Does；選項 D 主詞變成問人了。
questions.commonMisconception: 對於這類問句常常忽視答句的提示，亂猜選項 C 或 D。

questions.scenario: Two friends are talking about playing video games.
questions.question:
Friend A: Can you play baseball in the game?
Friend B: No, I can't. ___________________
questions.explanation: 已經說了 No, I can't.，在補述時也應該用 can't 來表達不會此技能。選項 B 是 am not + 原形動詞錯誤；選項 C 語氣轉為不玩而非不會玩；選項 D 是 I is 嚴重錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 用 am not 或 don't 當成 can't 的替代品，忘記維持『表達能力』的情態助動詞。

questions.scenario: A coach is asking a new player about his sports skills.
questions.question:
Coach: Let's play sports. ___________________
Player: Yes, I can. I like sports.
questions.explanation: 運動場上教練問技能，球員說 Yes, I can.，所以必定是 Can you...? 開頭。選項 B 為嚴重文法錯誤；選項 C 錯搭 Do；選項 D 錯換第三人稱主詞。
questions.commonMisconception: 混淆 Do you 與 Can you，認為它們可以完全替換。

questions.scenario: A girl is pointing at a bird in the cage.
questions.question:
Girl: The bird is beautiful. Can it sing?
Dad: ___________________
options: No, they can't. They have voices.
Yes, it is. It has a good voice.
No, it isn't. It has a good voice
Yes, it can. It has a good voice.
questions.explanation: 單隻鳥 The bird 代名詞為 it，Can 提問需用 can 回答。選項 A 前後一致。選項 B 錯搭 is；選項 C 語意矛盾；選項 D 人數不符 (they)。
questions.commonMisconception: 把 it is 當成萬用回答，忘記配合助動詞 can 的規則。

questions.scenario: Two students are organizing a band.
questions.question:
Student A: I can play the drums.
Student B: Wow! ___________________
Student A: No, he can't. He can sing.
options: Can Peter play the drums, too?
Can you play the drums, too?
Is Peter play the drums, too?
Does Peter play the drums, too
questions.explanation: 接下來的回答是 No, he can't.。所以問句的主詞必須是男性的第三人稱 (Peter)，並且以 Can 開頭。選項 B 錯用 you；選項 C 雙動詞錯誤；選項 D 錯搭 Does。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法結合對話中的主詞變化 (I -> he)，而死板板選了 Can you。

questions.scenario: A brother and sister want to play together but the sister is too small.
questions.question:
Brother: Let's ride a bike!
Mom: She is too young. ___________________
questions.explanation: 媽媽解釋妹妹因為太小，所以『不會』騎單車，表達能力缺乏用 can't。選項 B 加上 isn't 錯誤；選項 C 用 doesn't 語意是『她不騎』而不是『她不會騎』；選項 D 主詞針對錯誤的人 (指責哥哥)。
questions.commonMisconception: 分不清楚 can't (不會/不能) 和 doesn't (不) 在語意上的細微差別。
